paper.title: Cellular, structural and functional cardiac remodelling following pressure overload and unloading

causal_root.model: adult male C57BL/6 mouse transverse-aortic banding followed by delayed debanding
causal_root.establishment: 4 weeks of pressure overload with serial echocardiography and terminal tissue characterization in a matched 4-week PO group
causal_root.intervention: physical removal of the aortic band after 4 weeks
causal_root.post_intervention: echocardiography at 1 and 2 weeks after debanding; microscopy/histology at 2 weeks
causal_root.second_surgery_groups: 10 debanding and 10 sham-debanding mice; survivors reported as 8 unloading and 7 sham-unloading

mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M1_basis: Pressure-overload remodeling is documented through four weekly assessments and a separate 4-week PO tissue group before the debanding time point.
mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M2_basis: Debanding directly removes the imposed pressure load rather than targeting a downstream molecular pathway.
mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M3_basis: The same experimental root quantitatively follows cardiac mechanical/functional state with speckle-tracking radial strain and strain rate plus Doppler-derived load before and after unloading; dyssynchrony and altered radial strain rate resolve after debanding.
mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M4_reason_for_unknown: The authors explicitly use triple immunofluorescence (vimentin, alpha-SMA, desmin) to distinguish interstitial fibroblast/myofibroblast-associated cells from vascular smooth muscle and report substantial reduction after unloading, but the public article presents representative fields rather than a numerical lineage/state-resolved disappearance, apoptosis, clearance, or validated shutdown trajectory. Under the frozen UNKNOWN policy this cannot be promoted to an EXIT-trajectory YES.
mechanical_exit_coupling_audit.M5_reason_for_unknown: Structural/mechanical recovery is demonstrated in surviving animals, but the second operation had 25% perioperative mortality and the publication does not provide cause-specific safety attribution sufficient to certify preserved intervention integrity under the strict coupling rule.

important_identity_control.purpose: separate interstitial fibroblast/myofibroblast-associated staining from alpha-SMA-positive vascular smooth muscle
important_identity_control.boundary: Marker identity control is stronger than alpha-SMA alone but does not convert representative imaging into quantitative EXIT kinetics.

mechanics_observation.radial_strain: pressure-overload-associated LV strain abnormalities were ameliorated after unloading
mechanics_observation.dyssynchrony: posterior-versus-anterior time-to-peak radial strain difference resolved after debanding
mechanics_observation.radial_strain_rate: posterior LV wall increase after pressure overload resolved by debanding
mechanics_observation.boundary: strain/strain-rate are accepted as measured tissue mechanical state for M3; they are not relabeled as passive myocardial stiffness or elastic modulus

cell_state_observation.pre_unloading: 4-week banding increased the interstitial vimentin-expressing fibroblast fraction and the paper describes increased myofibroblast content as a pressure-overload remodeling feature
cell_state_observation.post_unloading: debanding substantially reduced vimentin-expressing fibroblasts toward sham levels

safety_boundary.interpretation: The intervention group does not numerically show excess survivors loss relative to sham surgery, but cause-specific attribution and repair-integrity evidence are insufficient for strict M5 certification. No inference from survivor counts is used to override UNKNOWN.

next_exact_resolution: retrieve supplementary data associated with DOI 10.1016/j.ijcard.2016.03.240 and test whether numerical myofibroblast-state quantification exists
determine whether perioperative deaths were procedure-specific and whether any myocardial structural failure occurred after successful debanding
if both M4 and M5 become directly documented in the same root, rerun the frozen coupling admission without changing any criterion
